title: Step 1 - Building a Random Forest Model in R: Regression Tutorial

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this AR tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: Here we are at the final round of regression with our final regression model, random forest regression.
cues.zh: 現在是迴歸部分最後一輪，最後的模型是隨機森林迴歸。

cues.en: In the previous section we saw the decision tree regression model.
cues.zh: 上一節介紹決策樹迴歸。

cues.en: So if now the decision tree regression doesn't have any secret for you then you will perfectly understand random forest regression, because a random forest is just a team of decision trees
cues.zh: 如果你已完全理解決策樹，就能理解隨機森林，因為它只是多棵決策樹的團隊，

cues.en: each one making some predictions of your dependent variable.
cues.zh: 各自預測應變數。

cues.en: And the ultimate prediction of the random forest itself is simply the average of the different predictions of all the different trees in the forest.
cues.zh: 隨機森林的最終預測，就是所有樹不同預測的平均。

cues.en: And actually at the end of the previous section about decision trees, I asked you an enigma.
cues.zh: 上一節結尾，我留了一個問題。

cues.en: The enigma was knowing the results we got with one tree, what would be the result with 10 trees or 100 trees or 500 trees, in terms of visualization and in term of prediction?
cues.zh: 已知道一棵樹的結果，那麼 10、100 或 500 棵樹，在圖形與預測方面會如何？

cues.en: So I hope that after watching the "Intuition Tutorial" made by Carrel you actually ask yourself this question and try to predict what's going to happen here
cues.zh: 希望看完 Kirill 的直覺教學後，你有思考並試著預測

cues.en: with random forest regression.
cues.zh: 隨機森林迴歸會發生什麼。

cues.en: So let's find out about that.
cues.zh: 現在找答案。

cues.en: We are gonna build our random forest regression model and see what happens.
cues.zh: 建立隨機森林迴歸模型，看看結果。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: We're gonna start by selecting the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 先選正確資料夾作為工作目錄。

cues.en: So it's in part two regression, and here is the final regression model we were building random forest regression.
cues.zh: 到 Part 2 Regression，這是最後要建立的模型 Random Forest Regression。

cues.en: So let's go inside, and that's the right folder we wanna set as working directory was the position salary CSV file.
cues.zh: 進入後，找到包含 Position_Salaries.csv 的資料夾。

cues.en: So let's click on this more button and set as working directory.
cues.zh: 點 More，再選 Set as Working Directory。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now let's take our regression template to build this model efficiently.
cues.zh: 現在用迴歸模板，有效率地建立模型。

cues.en: So we are actually going to take everything from here to the bottom but we will only include this code section to visualize the regression model results, because you understood that the decision tree
cues.zh: 複製這裡到最底部，但視覺化部分只保留這段，因為決策樹

cues.en: regression model is a non-continuous regression model.
cues.zh: 迴歸是不連續的模型。

cues.en: And since random forest is a combination of decision trees then it's a combination of non-continuous regression model.
cues.zh: 隨機森林是決策樹的組合，也就是不連續模型的組合。

cues.en: And intuitively we understand, we can guess that the random forest regression model is not going to be continuous either.
cues.zh: 直覺上可以推測，隨機森林迴歸也不連續。

cues.en: So since this code doesn't work for non-continuous regression model, we will actually use this one that works perfectly for it.
cues.zh: 這段程式不適用不連續模型，所以使用另一段正確的程式。

cues.en: So I'm going to copy this, paste that here and remove this section that is non-appropriate or non-con continuous regression models.
cues.zh: 我複製貼上，並移除不適合不連續模型的部分。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now the template is ready.
cues.zh: 模板準備好了。

cues.en: Let's change the basics.
cues.zh: 先修改基本內容。

cues.en: Let's replace here regression models by random forest regression, visualizing the random forest regression results
cues.zh: 將 Regression Model 換成 Random Forest Regression，還有視覺化隨機森林結果的標題，

cues.en: and fitting random forest regression to our data set.
cues.zh: 以及將隨機森林迴歸擬合至資料集的標題。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So now let's build a model, which is in this section here.
cues.zh: 現在在這裡建立模型。

cues.en: So let's remove this.
cues.zh: 先移除這段。

cues.en: And as usual, we're going to import the right library for the job and then use a function to build our random forest regressor.
cues.zh: 一樣匯入合適的套件，再使用函數建立隨機森林迴歸器。

cues.en: So the package we're going to import is called random forest.
cues.zh: 套件叫做 randomForest。

cues.en: So for those of you who don't have the package installed, in your packages here, well you can check it out.
cues.zh: 如果你的套件清單尚未安裝，可以先檢查。

cues.en: Mine is already installed because I used it before.
cues.zh: 我之前用過，所以已安裝。

cues.en: But I'm going to write this line here for those of you who need to install it.
cues.zh: 我替還沒安裝的人寫出這行。

cues.en: So install .packages('randomForest')
cues.zh: install.packages('randomForest')。

cues.en: All right, random forest.
cues.zh: 就是 randomForest。

cues.en: And so I'm not going to install it because mine is already installed.
cues.zh: 我已經安裝，所以不再安裝。

cues.en: So I'm gonna put that in comment.
cues.zh: 將這行註解掉。

cues.en: But if you wanna install it you just need to select this line as I just did and press command and control plus enter to execute it.
cues.zh: 如果要安裝，只需選取這一行，按 Command 或 Control+Enter 執行。

cues.en: And this will install the package properly.
cues.zh: 就會正確安裝。

cues.en: But here I'm gonna put in comment by pressing command plus shift plus C.
cues.zh: 我按 Command+Shift+C 將它註解。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now what we have to do is to add this, you know library random forest to actually automatically select the box here to import automatically
cues.zh: 現在加入 library(randomForest)，自動勾選並匯入

cues.en: the random forest package when we execute the whole code, or the section.
cues.zh: randomForest 套件，在執行全部程式或這一段時載入。

cues.en: So that's important.
cues.zh: 這很重要。

cues.en: And now time to build the regressor.
cues.zh: 現在建立迴歸器。

cues.en: So let's do it.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: We're gonna call regressor, regressor as usual to keep things simple and equals.
cues.zh: 為了簡單，一樣命名為 regressor，再加等號。

cues.en: And now the function that we're gonna use is also random forest, written the same.
cues.zh: 使用的函數也叫 randomForest，拼法相同。

cues.en: And so now let's add some parenthesis.
cues.zh: 加上括號。

cues.en: And now let's press F1 to have a look at the arguments.
cues.zh: 按 F1 查看引數。

cues.en: Okay, so the arguments are here and the first argument is, data.
cues.zh: 引數在這裡，第一個是 data。

cues.en: But as you can see it specifies that it's an optional data frame.
cues.zh: 不過它註明是選用的資料框。

cues.en: And we could use this argument to build our regressor, but, we're gonna use the main arguments to specify, you know the independent variables on one side and the dependent variable on another side.
cues.zh: 可以用這個引數建立模型，但這裡會透過主要引數，分別指定自變數與應變數。

cues.en: And to do this we're gonna use these two arguments, X and Y.
cues.zh: 使用 x 與 y 兩個引數。

cues.en: So X will contain the matrix of features that is the independent variables and Y will contain the dependent variable vector that is the salary column.
cues.zh: x 包含自變數的特徵矩陣，y 包含應變數向量，也就是 Salary 欄位。

cues.en: So let's first input these two arguments.
cues.zh: 先輸入這兩個引數。

cues.en: So the first argument is X = and so we have several ways to take our independent variables.
cues.zh: 第一個是 x=，有幾種方式取得自變數。

cues.en: So one of the way is to take our data set here and then choose the right columns of the independent variables.
cues.zh: 其中一種是從 dataset 選取正確的自變數欄位。

cues.en: And you know, our data set is composed of two columns.
cues.zh: 資料集包含兩欄。

cues.en: The first column index by one which is the independent variable column and the second column index by two which is our dependent variable column.
cues.zh: 第一欄索引為 1，是自變數；第二欄索引為 2，是應變數。

cues.en: So here we need index one because we want to take the independent, variable.
cues.zh: 所以這裡取索引 1，因為要自變數。

cues.en: All right, now, next argument.
cues.zh: 接著下一個引數。

cues.en: The next argument is Y the dependent viable vector.
cues.zh: 下一個是 y，也就是應變數向量。

cues.en: And now as you can see Y is expected to be a response vector.
cues.zh: 它預期接收回應向量。

cues.en: It's actually a vector.
cues.zh: 實際上就是向量。

cues.en: And here it expected to have a data frame.
cues.zh: 這裡則預期資料框。

cues.en: So by using this one index into brackets here I actually import a data frame.
cues.zh: 使用中括號索引 1，取得的是資料框。

cues.en: But here to get a vector I actually need to use another trick, another technique which is in there to use the dollar sign and then the name of the column, which is of course, salary.
cues.zh: 但要取得向量，需用另一種方式：美元符號，再加欄位名稱 Salary。

cues.en: And that will give me a vector.
cues.zh: 這樣就會得到向量。
